verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents triggers that run automatically when emails arrive, for example drafting replies, adding team comments, organizing threads into todos and connecting to 3,000+ apps. It also offers custom AI filters that label, star or archive mail using plain-English scripts, and a Tasklet integration that acts on emails automatically. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of trigger and rule configuration (event types beyond email arrival, conditions, action chaining), independent or hands-on corroboration that rules work reliably.
